title: UL tangent operator emission (Jaumann material + geometric stiffness)
objective: Extend `emit_tangent_matvec_kernel` to emit the linearised UL tangent K_{aibj} = integral(dN_a/dx_k c^Jau_{kijl} dN_b/dx_l + sigma_{ij} dN_a/dx_j dN_b/dx_i) dV when the configuration is CURRENT.

plan_assets.asset_description: B1.2 UL tangent equation with Jaumann-rate material term and geometric stiffness term.

scope: Emit the two-term UL tangent inside `tangent_matvec` with the same analytical-linearisation pattern introduced in Plan A §A7.5/§A9.2 — element-by-element over NumPy, no FD, no Taichi kernel for the tangent body.
Use the Jaumann-rate material tangent c^Jau produced by P1-5 for the material term.
Add the geometric stiffness term sigma_{ij} dN_a/dx_j dN_b/dx_i explicitly.
Dispatch on `configuration`: REFERENCE → the existing analytical push-forward path (unchanged); CURRENT → the new UL two-term path.
implementation_steps: Read the current `emit_tangent_matvec_kernel` (the analytical SVK/J2 body introduced in commit 2ae532a).
Factor the existing body into `emit_tl_tangent_body` (unchanged) and add a new `emit_ul_tangent_body` for the UL path.
The UL body computes grad_v from v_elem and spatial shape gradients, then sums the Jaumann-material contraction and the geometric stiffness directly.
Add emission-structure tests verifying both terms appear in the UL source and asserting TL emission is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: UL tangent source contains both the material term (using c^Jau) and the geometric stiffness term.
Plan A analytical TL tangent emission is unchanged (regression on the existing elastic golden).
No regressions on the 998 fast tests.

cases: UL tangent contains Jaumann material term
UL tangent contains geometric stiffness term
UL tangent matches handwritten UL reference within 1e-10 (deferred to P1-7)

risks: Jaumann rate tangent conversion from the C_IJKL material tangent is easy to get wrong. Mitigation: derive the formula symbolically with SymPy in a test and compare to the hand formula in 07-CONVENTIONS.md.

commands.command: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -m 'not slow and not gpu' -q

completion_notes: UL tangent operator emission implementing Plan B B1.2 two-term linearisation: Jaumann material term via c^Jau einsum contraction + geometric stiffness via Hadamard product sigma * grad_v. TL path refactored into helper function, unchanged. All gates passed on first attempt.
